dataset.title: SigmaFold ClinVar expert-consensus benchmark
dataset.dataNote: Real, public, de-identified variant annotations from ClinVar, gnomAD, dbNSFP (AlphaMissense), CADD and snpEff via MyVariant.info. No patient data: these are population-level reference records, not individual genomes.
dataset.inclusion: ClinVar review status of at least 2 stars (reviewed by expert panel, or criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts) and a consensus of Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic or Benign/Likely Benign under the evidence layer's own ClinVar parser (conflicting and VUS records excluded). Consequence (missense vs stop/frameshift/canonical splice) from the evidence layer's normaliser. Candidates come from 6 seeded random pages of 100 per stratum (all hits when fewer), shuffled with the seed, then taken in order with at most 5 variants per gene across the whole set.

strata.query: clinvar.rcv.review_status:("reviewed by expert panel" OR "criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts") AND clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance:("Benign" OR "Likely benign" OR "Benign/Likely benign") AND snpeff.ann.effect:(stop_gained OR frameshift_variant OR splice_acceptor_variant OR splice_donor_variant)

clinvar.rcv.review_status:("reviewed by expert panel" OR "criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts") AND clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance:("Pathogenic" OR "Likely pathogenic" OR "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") AND snpeff.ann.effect:(stop_gained OR frameshift_variant OR splice_acceptor_variant OR splice_donor_variant)

clinvar.rcv.review_status:("reviewed by expert panel" OR "criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts") AND clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance:("Pathogenic" OR "Likely pathogenic" OR "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") AND snpeff.ann.effect:missense_variant

clinvar.rcv.review_status:("reviewed by expert panel" OR "criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts") AND clinvar.rcv.clinical_significance:("Benign" OR "Likely benign" OR "Benign/Likely benign") AND snpeff.ann.effect:missense_variant

methods.name: SigmaFold classifier
methods.rule: interpret(evidence) with no human assertions: 8 scoped ACMG/AMP criteria, Tavtigian 2018 points. ClinVar is never visible to it.

methods.name: Baseline A: AlphaMissense alone
methods.rule: Missense only. Max score > 0.564 = P/LP, < 0.34 = B/LB, otherwise VUS (Cheng et al. 2023). No score or not missense = no call.

methods.name: Baseline B: population frequency alone
methods.rule: gnomAD max AF > 5% = B/LB (BA1); > 1% = B/LB (BS1); otherwise VUS. Rarity alone cannot argue pathogenic.

omittedMethods.reason: No variant in the benchmark carries a CADD score: MyVariant.info serves CADD for hg19 only, and the evidence layer queries hg38.
